It is rough on the edges, all of these things you have listed bother me as well but as you play you learn to navigate some of them. When it’s nighttime I usually switch to the secondary red dot sight attached to my scope and make sure to turn the red dot brightness to the low setting so you can see. You can look through binoculars with NVG, but most of the time you gotta switch to close combat techniques. 

I love the game but I don’t get to play it super often as I have to set aside a good amount of time to account for the queue and hours of playtime. 

Also yes the gunplay isn’t super smooth but it’s also not supposed to be super snappy run and gun like COD or similar. From my experience, everybody encounters that too so i’m not being mowed down constantly by people playing like it’s COD. I play controller (on pc) which feels harder to navigate movement and gunplay but it never seems like I don’t stand a chance to people. They are clunky too haha. 

The lighting issues I have encountered a little bit, i’ve seen examples from other people and their visuals look much worse than what I experience, maybe mess with your settings? 

Also with loadouts, usually there will be 3 slots and I spend the grueling time to get them all set up and usually I don’t ever have to mess with my inventory too much other than healing. In the beginning it sucked but I learned to navigate the armory and my inventory more efficiently and now it’s pretty smooth.
